# NumWorks Epsilon as an out-of-tree Zephyr module.
#
# Needs epsilon_sources.cmake next to this file, generated by scripts/epsilon_prepare.py
# from your own Epsilon checkout. Epsilon itself is not part of this module.

if(CONFIG_EPSILON)

set(EPSILON_SOURCES_FILE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/epsilon_sources.cmake)
if(NOT EXISTS ${EPSILON_SOURCES_FILE})
  message(FATAL_ERROR "epsilon_sources.cmake not found. Run scripts/epsilon_prepare.py /path/to/epsilon first.")
endif()
include(${EPSILON_SOURCES_FILE})
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${EPSILON_SOURCES_FILE})

zephyr_library_named(epsilon)

# Epsilon proper, as listed by its own build.
zephyr_library_sources(${EPSILON_C_SOURCES} ${EPSILON_CXX_SOURCES})

# Ion pieces from Epsilon that do not depend on the desktop simulator, plus the platform dummies.
set(_ion ${EPSILON_ROOT}/shared/ion/src)
zephyr_library_sources(
  ${_ion}/simulator/shared/circuit_breaker.cpp
  ${_ion}/simulator/shared/crc32.cpp
  ${_ion}/simulator/shared/compilation_flags.cpp
  ${_ion}/simulator/shared/device_name.cpp
  ${_ion}/simulator/shared/exam_bytes.cpp
  ${_ion}/simulator/shared/dummy/read_only_memory.cpp
  ${_ion}/shared/collect_registers.cpp
  ${_ion}/shared/dummy/clipboard.cpp
)

# The PicoCalc backend written for this port.
zephyr_library_sources(
  src/ion_zephyr.cpp
  src/epsilon_start.cpp
  src/epsilon_glue.c
)

zephyr_library_include_directories(${EPSILON_INCLUDES} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src)
# The application provides keys.h / lcd.h for the glue code.
zephyr_library_include_directories(${APPLICATION_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
zephyr_library_compile_definitions(${EPSILON_DEFINES} _GNU_SOURCE _DEFAULT_SOURCE)
zephyr_library_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-include${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/epsilon_compat.h>)

# Epsilon is compiled freestanding: no exceptions, no RTTI.
zephyr_library_compile_options(
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++23>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-threadsafe-statics>
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-ffp-contract=off>
  -w
)
foreach(_f ${EPSILON_FORCED_INCLUDES})
  zephyr_library_compile_options("$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-include${_f}>")
endforeach()

endif()
